scripts.name: 禁用 IPv6
scripts.description: 通过 sysctl 禁用 IPv6，重启后依然生效。恢复则删除 /etc/sysctl.conf 中对应行。
scripts.command:
cat >> /etc/sysctl.conf <<'SBEOF'
net.ipv6.conf.all.disable_ipv6 = 1
net.ipv6.conf.default.disable_ipv6 = 1
net.ipv6.conf.lo.disable_ipv6 = 1
SBEOF
sysctl -p
